results.content: We are delighted to invite you to the second workshop on **Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Operations Management Research (AIMOR)** at the heart of the Canadian Rocky Mountains. **Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Operations Management Research (AIMOR) Workshop**. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Operations Management Research (AIMOR). This two-day workshop is designed to explore and advance the integration of AI/ML into Operations Management research. Taking place on **May 14–15, 2026**, at the elegant Royal Canadian Lodge in the breathtaking town of Banff, this workshop provides an exceptional opportunity to present your work, and exchange cutting-edge ideas with world-class researchers at the forefront of AI applications in Operations Management. We are grateful for the generous support of the **Haskayne School of Business** at the University of Calgary to be able to organize this workshop as an “**all-inclusive**” event with discounted registration fees. Registration fee includes: **three nights of accommodation** at the Banff Inn and Charltons Banff, **breakfast**, **lunch** and **refreshments** on both workshop days, and **dinner** on May 14.
